purpose: Test whether ODI batting/bowling rate features benefit from explicit wickets-lost efficiency rather than only aggregate runs-per-ball and wickets-per-ball.
identified_weakness: O0 represents batting output with runs-per-ball and bowling output with wickets-per-ball, but does not explicitly represent how efficiently a team converts its batting opportunity while preserving wickets. ODI innings are materially longer than T20 innings, so wicket preservation can carry distinct signal beyond scoring rate alone.
single_controlled_change: Add one ODI-specific feature, team_a_minus_team_b_wicket_preservation_rate, defined from historical decisive innings as the signed difference in wickets-preserved rate: 1 - wickets_lost / batting_legal_balls_scaled_to_300, with each team's historical numerator and denominator accumulated strictly before the prediction date. No other O0 feature is changed.
decision_rule: O2 is accepted only if the single added feature produces credible improvement over frozen O0 across the pre-specified rolling-origin and independent future-holdout evaluation. Otherwise O0 remains the reference.
warning: The exact mathematical implementation must be finalized and tested against Cricsheet innings semantics before training; no result should be generated from this contract alone.
